rationale: Noventa Energy Partners Inc. and six related Noventa Group entities filed assignments in bankruptcy that became effective on March 20, 2026. MNP was appointed as licensed insolvency trustee, Noventa's company website now returns HTTP 404, and Noventa is absent from Ancala's current portfolio page. Retire Ancala's ownership period in 2026, mark the company realized because no other current owner remains, preserve the operating and investment history, and replace all three dead citations with durable current evidence.

acquisitionExitCheck.acquisitionSearch: Ancala's 2023 ESG report identifies Noventa as an Energy Transition and Renewables portfolio company with a 2023 entry date, corroborating the existing majority-investment history.
acquisitionExitCheck.exitSearch: No sale to a successor owner was found. The Noventa Group instead entered bankruptcy effective March 20, 2026, and Noventa no longer appears in Ancala's current portfolio.
acquisitionExitCheck.currentCompanyStatus: Noventa Energy Partners Inc. and related operating entities are bankrupt estates administered by MNP. The company website and the two existing Ancala Noventa articles return HTTP 404.
